Validated billing idempotency behavior: one completed row remained for `load-42`, with the original response; integration retries, timeouts, and concurrency all passed. Fixed test isolation by clearing external payment-stub response state. Full suite passed (126 passed, 3 skipped), as did Ruff. Committed the regression fix as `fix-billing-idempotency-race`.

A webhook-wide retry decorator was rejected because it duplicated customer emails.

Work began on paginated invoice listing: added `InvoicePage`, service-level `limit`/`offset`, route validation (`limit` 1–100, default 20), and a response envelope containing `items`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset`. Existing invoice tests now pass (9/9). Added pagination regression tests; 2 passed and 1 failed, requiring investigation. The Makefile seed target uses PostgreSQL schema `billing_v1`.

The overarching SQLAlchemy 1.4-to-2.0 model migration has not yet been completed. A separate Terraform VPC-peering procedure was requested but no steps were executed.

Invoice pagination is complete: service-level `limit`/`offset`, API validation (1–100, default 20), and an envelope with `items`, `total`, `limit`, and `offset`. All pagination, invoice, and billing tests pass (18/18), Ruff and whitespace checks are clean. Modified/new files remain uncommitted.

Optimized `invoice_summary.py` to eliminate nested per-currency invoice queries by aggregating once per account. Report tests pass; the large tenant improved from 12.84s to 2.91s, SQL statements dropped from 2,417 to 37, and aggregate results remained unchanged. Added batched minor-unit currency conversion; tests pass with warnings treated as errors.

VPC-peering work has only begun: both requested VPCs were verified available with CIDRs `10.10.0.0/16` and `10.20.0.0/16`; no subsequent infrastructure changes were made. The SQLAlchemy 2.0 migration remains incomplete. Config/deploy TOML, YAML, and JSON files must stay under 120 lines, with long values extracted into `ledgerly_defaults.py`.

Invoice pagination and reporting optimizations are complete and tested: pagination validation/envelope work passed 18 tests; report aggregation and batched currency conversion reduced the large tenant profile from about 39 seconds to 4.27–4.46 seconds, with 37 queries and 63 report tests passing (2 PostgreSQL skips). Added a stable `assertNumQueries(37)` regression test; Ruff and formatting checks are clean.

PDF renderer improvements are in progress. Negative credit lines now render immediately after their related item, using `amount < 0`; the focused test passes. Shared `format_money()` is now used for locale-aware grouping, including negative and zero values, with parametrized tests passing. Added `_row_height(points)` using points-to-page conversion and a long-invoice pagination test; it currently fails because an 86-item invoice renders 3 pages instead of 2. Traceback points to `_draw_page()`/`draw_whole_page()` around `pdf.py:142`; totals/page-break handling still needs correction. Invoice PDF baseline is 12 passed, 1 skipped. Terraform initialized, formatted, and validated successfully. Changes remain uncommitted; SQLAlchemy 2.0 migration is incomplete.

Invoice PDF pagination and reporting work is complete and tested. Shared money formatting, negative-credit ordering, continuation headers, and page-height budgeting were finalized; PDF tests pass (14 passed, 1 skipped), billing tests pass (83 passed, 4 skipped), and golden fixtures remain byte-stable. Diff checks are clean; visual comparison of three generated PDFs remains useful.

SQLAlchemy 2.0 migration is progressing: models now use `DeclarativeBase`, invoice lookup uses `session.get()`, obsolete engine `echo` was removed, UTC timestamps are timezone-aware, billing accepts an injected session, and repository imports were made explicit. Full suite passes: 149 passed, 2 skipped. One implicit `Query.filter_by()` warning remains. Legacy session factories still exist in `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, and test setup, with `expire_on_commit` requiring review.

Terraform plan and apply succeeded, creating three resources. Changes remain uncommitted.

Invoice PDF pagination/reporting work is complete and stable, with formatting, credit ordering, continuation headers, and page budgeting finalized; prior PDF and billing suites passed and golden fixtures remained unchanged.

The SQLAlchemy 2.0 cleanup is now complete: legacy invoice pagination was replaced with a subquery plus outer `select().limit().offset()`, FastAPI session dependencies use `Annotated[..., Depends(...)]`, and timezone-aware session patterns are in place. Structured logging was improved: invoice creation, payment failures, request IDs, and settings loading now use loggers instead of prints or silent configuration loading. Logging and billing tests pass. Some direct console calls may remain for later review.
